name: Doubao & Qwen AI Agent Builders
description: ByteDance's Doubao and Alibaba's Qwen both kill their AI-agent creation features on July 15. Existing user-built agents stop functioning entirely — timed to China's new Interim Measures for Anthropomorphic AI Interaction Services taking effect the same day.

name: OpenAI Fine-tuning (new orgs)
description: New organizations can no longer create fine-tuning jobs. Existing jobs will stop on July 23, with a second wave October 23.

name: OpenAI Atlas (AI Browser)
description: OpenAI's ChatGPT-powered web browser, launched October 2025, stops working August 9 — less than a year old. The agentic browsing features are being redistributed into ChatGPT's desktop app and a Chrome extension instead.

name: OpenAI Assistants API
description: Persistent AI agents with memory, tools, and file handling. Replaced by the Responses API. Developers face a full rewrite.

name: Sora API
description: While the Sora app died in April, the API endpoint survives until September. Then it's gone completely.

name: Gemini 2.5 Pro / Flash / Flash Lite
description: Google's entire Gemini 2.5 family on Vertex AI will be retired no earlier than October 16, 2026.

name: OpenAI Legacy GPT Image Models
description: Older GPT Image model snapshots were flagged for removal from the API on December 1, 2026, just months after they replaced DALL·E. The endpoint that buried DALL·E is already on its own deprecation clock.
